## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo fmt`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo test` pass
- [ ] Tests cover the change
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line under **Unreleased** (if users will notice)
- [ ] `docs/PROJECT.md` is updated if a design decision, known limit, or roadmap item changed
- [ ] `VERSION` in `src/db.rs` is bumped if extraction or the schema changed
